writeup.1: The premise is simple and slightly stupid, which is the best kind. You come into money, and not the comfortable sort. Where in Austin do you go and play golf?
writeup.2: Twelve private clubs sit in and around town and out into the Hill Country, and the architecture is better than most people expect. Coore and Crenshaw are here. So are Pete and Alice Dye, on Lake Austin, and Nicklaus twice, and Fazio. One of the twelve is the only golf course Jimmy Demaret ever designed, which happens to be the reason the senior tour exists. Another, as of last October, is David McLay Kidd’s first course in Texas.
writeup.3: What any of it costs is the harder question, and the answer is more interesting than a number.
writeup.4: The golf comes first, because that is the fun part. The door comes second, because that is the honest part of any private club.
